caption: The drawing features three bonnets, with the largest and most prominent one positioned to the left, rendered in detail and colored in shades of mauve with a slightly lighter interior and two parallel dark purple stripes running along its length. The bonnet has a ruffled edge at the front and long trailing lappets. On the right side of the image, there are two additional bonnet sketches in pencil without color, one above the other. Both of these show the same basic bonnet shape with added lace or ribbon detailing at the front and a bow near the base where the lappets start. The background of the drawing is an off-white or light beige color, and the artist’s signature, "M. Gonchar," appears in the lower right corner beneath the two sketched bonnets.
title: Bonnet
